CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD_INVALID.zhs: 密码长度为 8–64 个字符，不能全部为空白，也不能与当前密码相同。
CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD_INVALID.en: Use 8–64 characters. The password cannot be entirely whitespace or the same as your current password.

CREDENTIAL_UNCHANGED.zhs: 新密码不能与当前密码相同。
CREDENTIAL_UNCHANGED.en: The new password must differ from the current password.

IDENTITY_REVISION_CONFLICT.zhs: 账号已发生变化，请重新登录后重试。
IDENTITY_REVISION_CONFLICT.en: Your account has changed. Sign in again before retrying.

IDENTITY_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND.zhs: 账号不存在，请重新登录。
IDENTITY_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND.en: The account no longer exists. Sign in again.

IDENTITY_ACCOUNT_DELETED.zhs: 账号已删除，无法修改密码。
IDENTITY_ACCOUNT_DELETED.en: This account was deleted and its password cannot be changed.
